name: mech-resources-topbar
what: The top bar's food, materials and gold and the food bar, with a peasant walking home carrying wood (its load arc showing) in view

game.note: A few minutes into a skirmish so stocks have moved; a woodcutter selected on its way to deliver; daylight, clouds off

name: mech-peasants-at-work
what: Peasants farming, chopping trees and carrying goods to a village, the peasant activity panel above the minimap open with its five rows

game.note: A town some minutes in with farms and woodcutters near a village; open the peasant activity panel (the minimap's top arc) to its five-row state

name: mech-food-support
what: The top bar's food bar and population with the army's consumption above the food support (the bar in the red)

game.note: A skirmish with few farmers and a large army so consumption exceeds support; crop to the top bar's right half

name: mech-peasants-dusk
what: Peasants walking from the fields into a village at dusk, the sky reddening

game.note: Skirmish with Seasons & Weather: day and night on, Peasants sleep at night on, short day; camera over a village at the moment daylight drops below half

name: mech-city-placement
what: A city building being placed at the end of a street of the city: the green footprint and the new palisade's banner poles moving out around it

game.note: A town with a few city buildings; pick a Barracks from the build menu and hold it at the city's edge, touching the walls, before clicking

name: mech-alignment-menu
what: The build menu's Alignment tab with some buildings available and some shown as ghost icons because another path's building was built

game.note: A town with an Observatory finished, so the Michael Statue and others show their ghost icons; hover one so its tooltip names the reason

name: mech-combat-archers-hill
what: Archers on a hill shooting down at cavalry in the valley, arrows in flight

game.note: A test setup or late skirmish: a line of archers on high ground, enemy horsemen approaching from below; daylight, clouds off; a known camera above ground

name: mech-experience-arc
what: The selection panel of a veteran knight with most of the 16-segment experience arc lit

game.note: A knight with high experience (raise it with the cheat panel or after fights); crop to the lower left panel

name: mech-research-blacksmith
what: A Blacksmith selected, its command panel showing the armour and weapon research buttons, some lit, some greyed

game.note: A town with a finished Blacksmith and some resources; hover one research button so its tooltip shows the effect

name: mech-formations-line-orb
what: A Line of pikemen holding against charging cavalry, with an Orb of infantry behind it

game.note: Two formed formations of 8+ heavy infantry (one Line, one Orb) and enemy cavalry attacking the Line's front; daylight, clouds off

name: mech-movement-road
what: A column of soldiers marching along a cobbled road past a forest

game.note: A map with cobbles leading out of a town; a Column formation moving along it; camera low, daylight

name: mech-siege-trebuchet
what: A trebuchet and mangonels shelling a stone wall, a stone in flight, pikemen guarding the engines

game.note: Late skirmish or test setup with an enemy town walled in stone; unpacked trebuchet in range; daylight, clouds off

name: mech-naval-cog
what: A Cog at a dock with pikemen walking aboard

game.note: A map with water and no AI Generals (docks need that); a finished Dock, a Cog moored, foot soldiers ordered to board

name: mech-fog-hill-scout
what: The fog of war around two scouts, one on a hilltop lighting a much wider circle than one in the valley; the minimap showing both circles

game.note: Clear Fog Of War off; two scouts, one on high ground, one low; camera high enough to show both lit areas

name: mech-night-town
what: A town at midnight under a full moon: lit windows, darker fog of war, a short night sight circle around a unit in the fields

game.note: Seasons & Weather: day and night on, moon fixed at full, start hour 0; camera over the town; clouds off

name: mech-weather-winter
what: A town in a harsh winter: snow on roofs and ground, fields fallow, the river frozen; the top bar showing the temperature below zero and 'fields fallow'

game.note: Seasons on, start season winter, winter harsh, weather snow forced with the cheat panel (F9); a town by a river

name: mech-weather-flood
what: Heavy rain over a river that has risen over its banks onto low land, the top bar showing the weather

game.note: Seasons on, weather heavy rain forced (F9) for some minutes so the water rises; a low riverside on a map with shores

name: mech-diplomacy-offer
what: The Diplomacy window with an alliance offer from an AI General blinking (Accept Offer), and the General's message window with portrait

game.note: Skirmish with Allow Diplomacy on and no teams; wait for or force an AI offer (script chat) and open the Diplomacy window

name: mech-disguise-spy
what: An enemy spy disguised as one of the player's own peasants next to a priest who has just unmasked it

game.note: Test setup: an enemy Spy walking into the player's town, one of the player's Priests nearby; shoot before and after the unmasking if possible

name: mech-hero-panel
what: The selection panel of a hero: name with epithet and laurel, 'born' line, age and kills

game.note: A unit past the hero threshold (raise its kills with a test hook, or a long AI game); select it; crop to the lower left panel

name: mech-ai-lobby
what: The skirmish lobby's players tab with three AI Generals of different tiers and a Lua AI shown after one name ([Advanced])

name: mech-victory-message
what: The victory message window after the last enemy Manor fell, with Return to Game and Exit to Main Menu

game.note: A 2-player skirmish where the enemy's last Manor-type building is destroyed (test hook or cheat panel); take the shot as the window opens

name: mech-campaign-map
what: The campaign map with some provinces conquered (in their region colours), target markers on their neighbours and the panel showing the chosen province

name: mech-multiplayer-lobby
what: A multiplayer host lobby with two humans and an AI General, the Settings tab's host options (AI takes over, spectators, mods policy) visible

name: mech-replay-viewer
what: A replay playing: the controls under the top panel, the progress bar with red and white event ticks, a battle announced at the top

game.note: Play a recorded AI game with the benchmark's replay hook, some minutes in, during a battle

name: mech-mods-screen
what: The Mods screen with two mods enabled, one moved so the own load order is in use
